scope: Read-only review of prior TSMOM research before a new fixed BTC/ETH/SOL flow study. No new strategy metrics were computed.

legacy_trial_count.limitation: The source trial record has artifact_generation_verified=false. Several prior session reports also have artifact_generation_verified=false, and the regenerated trend-persistence report is BLOCKED because all six frozen data identities changed. Do not use the reported DSR as reproducible evidence.

btc_eth_sol_trend_persistence.basis: Three recorded ROC, Donchian, and EMA strategy artifacts. Results are historical reports only; artifact generation is unverified.

btc_eth_sol_vol_targeted.basis: Three recorded strategy artifacts. Results are not validated.

btc_eth_sol_maker_regime.basis: Three recorded strategy artifacts. Results are not validated.

top10_universe.basis: Four recorded strategy artifacts. The results contain materially different Sharpe fields and are not validated.

two_stage_execution.basis: Reported in trial_4_holdout_and_dsr_audit/result.json. The artifact is unverified. Treat the 2025-01 through 2026-07 period as previously accessed, not as a clean holdout.

observations: Recorded 72-hour ROC Rank IC at the 72-hour horizon was 0.0116 pooled, below the old 0.015 threshold; the per-symbol values were uneven.
Several other pooled horizon results were negative or close to zero. The file reports conventional p-values and does not establish serial-dependence-adjusted significance.

selection_policy.historical_window: Treat all data through 2026-07-31 as development or previously accessed evidence. Do not present it as confirmatory holdout evidence.
selection_policy.prospective_holdout: 2026-08-01 through 2027-07-31; no values or outcomes have been accessed for this study.
selection_policy.new_search: Freeze only the user-approved 24h, 72h, and 168h TSMOM specifications plus one diagnostic-only flow comparison. Do not add variants after observing outcomes.
selection_policy.multiple_testing: The legacy audit reports 24 cumulative trials. Count at least those 24 before adding new strategy trials. A corrected DSR remains unreproducible until the complete legacy trial roster and artifacts are reconciled.
